articles.title: Newly Hired Petrol Pump Employee Flees With ₹90k Collection On First Day In Indore
articles.description: An employee allegedly fled with ₹90,000 from an Indore petrol pump after working his first day on July 21. Vijay Singh, hired after submitting his Aadhaar and completing training, disappeared when staff were depositing the day’s collection at 11 pm. Annapurna police registered a theft case on Saturday and launched a search after his phone was found switched off.

articles.title: E20 petrol damaging vehicles? Govt issues fact-check amid concerns over chloride, moisture contamination
articles.description: Intense debate continues over ethanol-blended petrol in India amid allegations of moisture contamination and high chloride levels. Government and industry reject claims, emphasizing rigorous testing and safety assurances.
